title: Preparation of 5N Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)
author: Jacquelina Woods
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byfsptne

steps.title: Measure water volume
steps.instruction: Measure 14.6 mL of deionized or ultrapure water into a sterile container.

steps.title: Add acid to water
steps.instruction: Slowly add 10.4 mL of Hydrochloric Acid (HCl) (Fisher Scientific Catalog #6000710 or equivalent) to the water while working in a chemical fume hood.

steps.title: Store solution
steps.instruction: Store the prepared 5 N HCl solution at room temperature.
